newsitem.title: USA: IDEXX completes acquisition of Idetek Inc.
newsitem.headline: IDEXX completes acquisition of Idetek Inc.

text.p: IDEXX Laboratories Inc said it had completed its acquisition of Idetek Inc for about $20 million worth of IDEXX common stock.
The company had earlier described the acquisition as a pooling of interests stock transaction.

Based in Sunnyvale, California, Idetek has about 40 employees who specialize in diagnosic methods for the food, agricultural and environmental industries. With revenues totalling $5 million in 1995, one of its products is a test kit for antibiotic residues in milk and meat.
IDEXX, based in Westbrook, Maine, also specializes in diagnostic products, exporting them to more than 50 countries.
